home.manifestoBody: FWU is more than a single day. We run the platform once a season, but the most valuable part is what happens after — people meet, launch joint projects, shoot campaigns. FWU is not a day, it's a process.
home.featuredDesignersSub: Designers, brands and authors shaping the ecosystem
home.latestEditionSub: Editor’s choice — limited drops, runway pieces, capsule collections
home.footerLine: A national next-generation fashion platform — fashion, business, art, collaborations.
home.quoteHero2: an environment where new names and directions are born.

designers.title: Designers
designers.subtitle: A curated directory of 20 Ukrainian fashion brands on the Fashion West Ukraine platform — designers from Transcarpathia, Lviv and Kyiv, their collections, stories and FWU runway appearances.

popup.title: Pop-Up
popup.subtitle: Curated fashion selection. Not a shop, not a marketplace — a space of selected fashion pieces.
popup.inquireBody: Each piece is part of a limited drop or capsule. For an inquiry, write to us — the platform manager will respond within the working day.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: FWU is an ecosystem of initiatives: designer runway shows, the FWU Models Awards, a fashion hackathon, educational programmes and international collaborations with European fashion institutions.
projects.showsBody: Runway shows of platform designers and brands in Transcarpathia, scaling to Ukraine and Europe.
projects.modelsBody: An award shaping the new modelling scene of the country — from new faces to professional standards.
projects.hackathonBody: An intensive where designers, technologists and entrepreneurs prototype new fashion products.
projects.internationalBody: Joint projects with European institutions of fashion, culture and business.
projects.educationBody: Schools, lectures and workshops on beauty, styling and the business of fashion.
projects.futureBody: New formats appearing as the platform develops. Reserved for partners and ecosystem members.

collab.title: Collaboration
collab.subtitle: Working directions with the FWU platform — for designers, brands, media, sponsors and international partners. Send a request and our platform manager will reply within one business day.
collab.designersBody: Submission to the curated directory, participation in shows and Pop-Up.
collab.mediaBody: Media partnership, event accreditation, exclusive materials.
collab.sponsorsBody: Sponsorship packages, brand visibility, closed events for the audience.
collab.internationalBody: Collaborations with European brands, institutions and showrooms.
collab.formNote: A platform manager will get back to you within the working day.

partners.specialServices: Special services — partner services on privileged terms.
partners.closedExperiences: Closed partner experiences — formats unavailable to the wider audience.
